CR-001.title: Stop return-premium credits from inflating the sweepable trust balance
CR-001.closedNote: resolved: `sweepable()` now counts unrefunded credits, clamps payables and caps `available` at trust cash. The remaining cross-carrier netting is tracked as CR-026.

CR-002.title: Let a renewal term be renewed again (Renewal tab dead-ends on any term that has a prior)
CR-002.closedNote: resolved: `RenewalTab` shows the prior-term comparison above the stage and renew forms and returns early only when already renewed.

CR-003.title: Stop treating Outlook replies as forwards in email intake
CR-003.closedNote: resolved: `detectForward` needs a forward prefix or a verified staff sender, and `newContent` stops at the underscore separator.

CR-004.title: Record pending-cancellation outcomes as real cancellations (automation flips status silently)
CR-004.closedNote: resolved: automation calls `finalizeCancellation` per policy in a transaction, and the policy page offers "Cancel now".

CR-005.title: Keep certificates from showing as valid on cancelled or expired policies
CR-005.closedNote: resolved: `issueCertificate` validates the policies, and the page, the PDF and redelivery check `policiesNotInForce`. Cancellation and expiry raise a holder-notice task.

CR-006.title: Pay producers on commission actually collected, not on invoice issue month
CR-006.closedNote: resolved: statements pick up collected, not-yet-paid lines by receipt or deposit date, tracked through `invoice_line_id` and `commission_line_id`.

CR-007.title: Do not overwrite the carrier's deposit with the reconciled total when posting a commission statement
CR-007.closedNote: resolved: posting uses the stored deposit, and `setStatementDeposit` edits it only on drafts. The default at intake is now CR-032.

CR-008.title: Make sender-domain matching exact before treating it as confident
CR-008.closedNote: resolved: exact host comparison, `LIMIT 2` with ambiguity rejected, and a configurable threshold.

CR-009.title: Move the task to the right account manager when staff confirm the email's client
CR-009.closedNote: resolved: shared-inbox tasks move to the client's account manager, and `requirePerm("write")` was added.

CR-010.title: Default renewal commission to the carrier's renewal rate
CR-010.closedNote: resolved: `defaultCommissionPct` is used for renewals and for rewrites.

CR-011.title: Guard cancel and reinstate by status and reverse the return-premium credit on reinstatement
CR-011.closedNote: resolved: status checks under `FOR UPDATE`, the pending notice is reused, and reinstatement voids the credit or raises a bill-back task.

CR-012.title: Match commission lines to the term in effect, and within the carrier
CR-012.closedNote: resolved: `findTermForLine` filters by carrier and orders by the term containing the line date.

CR-013.title: Run money check-then-write operations atomically
CR-013.closedNote: resolved: advisory lock on the sweep, receipt balances read under `FOR UPDATE`, and producer statements built in a transaction. Duplicate `applyTo` ids are folded into CR-027.

CR-014.title: Make deactivating a user stop their access and surface their open work
CR-014.closedNote: resolved: middleware and `currentUser` refuse inactive users, `session_version` is bumped, and the team queue flags inactive owners.

CR-016.title: Make the GL export GET side-effect free
CR-016.closedNote: resolved: the download writes nothing, `markExportedAction` is a POST, and an unknown `kind` returns 400.

CR-017.title: Generate collision-free client, lead and carrier codes
CR-017.closedNote: resolved: clients, carriers and leads use `nextNumber()`.

CR-018.title: Bound the Claude latency on the inbound email webhook
CR-018.closedNote: resolved: 15 s timeout with no retries for email, and the insert uses `ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING`.

CR-019.title: Refuse a carrier policy-fee invoice without a policy

CR-020.title: Make the cancellation return-premium field explicit
CR-020.closedNote: resolved: pre-filled by days over the actual term length.

CR-021.title: Format dates in the agency time zone everywhere
CR-021.closedNote: resolved: the tasks and commission pages use `whenDate` and `when`. One leftover is noted in CR-033.

CR-022.title: Replace the hard-coded 2026 year start in renewal stats
CR-022.closedNote: resolved: the renewals page uses `date_trunc('year', ...)`. Other pages are covered by CR-033.

CR-023.title: Move ledger rows when merging clients
CR-023.closedNote: resolved: `ledger_entries` is included, and the moved-row counts are audited.

CR-024.title: Add DB tests on the riskiest money and lifecycle paths

CR-025.title: Move workflow thresholds into settings
CR-025.closedNote: resolved: `lib/settings.ts` defaults, exposed in Admin > Settings, and `waiting_followup_days` is now read.

CR-026.title: Work out carrier obligations per carrier so one carrier's return can't offset what others are owed
CR-026.closedNote: resolved: `sweepable()` groups `carrier_payable` by `carrier_id`, subtracts each carrier's uncollected share, then clamps. The trust page and CSV show the per-carrier sum, and a two-carrier test was added.

CR-027.title: Treat unapplied receipt cash as a client obligation and stop double-applying a receipt
CR-027.closedNote: resolved: the remainder becomes a refundable credit (`source_receipt_id`) counted in `credits`, `applyTo` is de-duplicated, and reversal voids the credit. The missing apply-to-debit path is now CR-037.

CR-028.title: Move the email's attachments and policy when staff correct its client
CR-028.closedNote: resolved: `relinkEmail` moves documents, drops a policy that belongs to another client, and the activity's policy follows the client change.

CR-029.title: Give a fresh production deployment an administrator
CR-029.closedNote: resolved: `currentUser` provisions `bootstrapAdmin()` as admin when no active admin exists. The leftover doc drift is now CR-042.

CR-030.title: Show unassigned open tasks in Team priorities
CR-030.closedNote: resolved: `teamQueue` uses a `LEFT JOIN` and labels these tasks "Unassigned".

CR-031.title: Refuse endorsements on policies that aren't in force
CR-031.closedNote: resolved: `endorsePolicy` checks status and term dates under `FOR UPDATE`, and the card requires `inForce`.

CR-032.title: Freeze commission statement lines once posted, and don't default the deposit to the line total
CR-032.closedNote: resolved: `lockDraft` guards `addLineAction` and `lineAction`, a blank deposit is stored as NULL, and posting refuses a missing deposit.

CR-033.title: Replace the remaining hard-coded 2026 year starts and server-locale dates
CR-033.closedNote: resolved: YTD figures use `date_trunc('year', …)` or `yearStart()`, the ledger shows 24 months, and the bare `toLocaleDateString()` is gone. Only the audit CSV link's `from=2026-01-01` remains, which is an all-history export.

CR-034.title: Add rolled-back tests for the new money and intake findings

CR-035.title: Rank the team queue in SQL instead of loading every open task
CR-035.closedNote: resolved: `teamQueue` filters to queue members in SQL, works out premium once per client and caps at 1,000 rows. The `queueFor` and seed leftovers are folded into CR-043.

CR-036.title: Stop daily automation from chasing client credits as past-due invoices
CR-036.closedNote: resolved: step 6 requires `i.total > 0`, the "Past due" and "Open" tabs filter on `i.total > 0`, and migration 007 cancels the tasks already raised in error.

CR-037.title: Let a client credit be applied to an open invoice, and stop the receipt form netting credits
CR-037.closedNote: resolved: `applyCredit` writes a zero-amount `credit` receipt with paired applications under `FOR UPDATE`, and the billing tab offers it. The receipt form lists only positive invoices and points to the credit. A test covers it.

CR-038.title: File held attachments when staff click "Looks right"
CR-038.closedNote: resolved: `reviewedAction` calls `relinkEmail` when documents are held, and the warning now shows whenever any attachment has no client.

CR-039.title: Refuse to renew a cancelled or lost policy
CR-039.closedNote: resolved: `renewPolicy` refuses `NOT_RENEWABLE` statuses, `RenewalTab` hides the form for them, and a test covers it.

CR-040.title: Use the waiting-follow-up settings in the task focus view
CR-040.closedNote: resolved: the focus view's date input is now empty by default, so `waitingAction` falls back to the setting.

CR-041.title: Show the real count of emails to triage on My Day
CR-041.closedNote: resolved: the query selects `count(*) OVER ()` and keeps `LIMIT 6` for the list.

CR-042.title: Bring the deploy docs in line with `SEED_ON_EMPTY=0` and the bootstrap admin
CR-042.closedNote: resolved: the README, the `fly-deploy.sh` header and the `fly.toml` comment now describe an empty first boot and the bootstrap administrator.

CR-043.title: Share one migration runner, lock it, and drop the per-row premium subquery from `queueFor`
CR-043.closedNote: resolved: `scripts/migrate-core.mjs` is shared by the server and the seed, takes `pg_advisory_lock`, and `queueFor` uses the grouped premium join.

CR-044.title: Stop counting already-paid carrier lines as "uncollected" in the sweep limit
CR-044.closedNote: resolved: the `u` query now excludes carrier lines with a `carrier_statement_id`, and a rolled-back test covers the NSF case.

CR-045.title: Treat reversing a refund as voiding the refund, not as an NSF with negative journal lines
CR-045.closedNote: resolved: `reverseReceipt` posts positive, swapped lines for a refund, and the receipts page says "Void refund". The negative-line risk that remains on other paths is CR-051.

CR-046.title: Add rolled-back tests for the CR-036, CR-038 and CR-044 fixes
CR-046.closedNote: resolved: all three tests are in `review-fixes-db.test.ts`.

CR-047.title: Stop an action on a joined email from changing the shared non-pay task
CR-047.closedNote: resolved: `emailTask` detects a shared task. `ignoreEmail` leaves a note, `retypeAction` refuses, and `linkClientAction` leaves the task in place.

CR-048.title: Refuse to guess a client when the sender is on several, and never match a merged client
CR-048.closedNote: resolved: the sender query is `DISTINCT … status <> 'inactive' LIMIT 2` and is treated as ambiguous when two clients match. The domain and name queries exclude inactive clients, and a merge clears `email` and `website` on the dropped client.

CR-049.title: Provide a way to record the real policy number after binding
CR-049.closedNote: resolved: an audited `setPolicyNumber` and `policyNumberAction` were added, and `markIssued` requires a real number in place of a `PENDING-` placeholder.

CR-050.title: Check certificate wording on every line, or warn that it wasn't checked
CR-050.closedNote: resolved: `verifyWording` checks `lob` plus every `policy_lines` entry, has BOP rules, and warns on lines it can't check (umbrella, and parts of auto and BOP). `renewCertificates` holds any certificate with warnings and raises a task.

CR-051.title: Stop net-negative statements from posting phantom cash
CR-051.closedNote: resolved: `post()` swaps negative amounts to the other side, and migration 008 adds a `CHECK` constraint (`NOT VALID`, so older rows aren't checked). A return-only carrier now needs "record return" with a deposit reference, and negative producer statements are refused and net into the next one.

CR-052.title: Set `issued_at` on in-force policies so missing-commission detection works
CR-052.closedNote: resolved: `createPolicy` writes `issued_at` for `active` policies, migration 008 backfills it from issued transactions, and a rolled-back test covers it.

CR-053.title: Guard refunds against voided credits and uncollected money

CR-054.title: Reset wholesaler and admitted status when a renewal moves carriers

CR-055.title: Don't record an unreadable policy PDF as checked

CR-056.title: Clamp term expiration dates at the end of the month

CR-057.title: Stop counting a renewed policy twice as in-force premium

CR-058.title: Validate cancellation dates and keep coverage in force until a future date

CR-060.title: Close or update open work when a policy's status changes

CR-061.title: Keep a malformed email from failing intake on every retry

CR-063.title: Print the VIN on ID cards for vehicles added in the app

CR-064.title: Refuse task transitions on a closed task

CR-065.title: Tell staff when an attachment was dropped at intake

CR-066.title: Show each policy check once in its history

CR-067.title: Keep the primary line when "Additional lines" are ticked

CR-068.title: Use the export stamp so late postings can be identified

CR-070.title: Define invoice balance in one place

SEC-001.title: Stop serving uploaded and emailed SVG/images inline from the app origin
SEC-001.closedNote: resolved: `storedMime` checks the type against the file's first bytes when the file is saved. `documentHeaders` sends only a verified PDF or image inline; everything else downloads as `octet-stream` with a `sandbox` CSP.

SEC-002.title: Restrict the audit trail, sign-in reports, CSV exports and system page by role
SEC-002.closedNote: resolved: `denied("admin")` now guards audit, system and users-report pages, `reports.all` or `accounting.view` guards the other report pages, and the CSV route has a per-report permission map. `audit()` masks PII.

SEC-003.title: Make deactivation and login removal end access immediately
SEC-003.closedNote: resolved: middleware checks `users.has()`, `active`, `session_version` and `revoked_sessions`. Deactivation bumps the version, and sign-out revokes the cookie's hash.

SEC-004.title: Reject control characters in the sign-in `next` redirect
SEC-004.closedNote: resolved: `safeLocalPath` refuses control characters, spaces and backslashes, and parses the value with `URL`.

SEC-005.title: Enforce role checks on task, inbox, note and account Q&A actions
SEC-005.closedNote: resolved: `mayActOn` now requires owner, unassigned or `team`. Inbox actions require `write`, `simulateAction` is admin-only, and `askAction` uses a hard `requirePerm`.

SEC-006.title: Move the accounting permission check out of the layout into each page

SEC-007.title: Make "confidential" notes actually restricted
SEC-007.closedNote: resolved: `hideConfidential` is applied on the task and client pages, and the audit summary reads "Confidential note added".

SEC-008.title: Trust a provider's authentication result only when the provider itself added it

SEC-009.title: Delimit untrusted text in Claude prompts and constrain what the model can set
SEC-009.closedNote: resolved: `<untrusted>` blocks plus a system rule; AI can raise a task to `urgent` only if the keyword rules agree; `due_in_days` is clamped to 0-60; subjects carry the code label and the "AI summary of an external email" prefix.

SEC-010.title: Neutralize spreadsheet formulas in CSV exports
SEC-010.closedNote: resolved: a shared `csvCell` adds a leading apostrophe to cells starting with `= + - @`, tab or CR, and leaves plain numbers alone.

SEC-011.title: Upgrade mailparser: inbound mail reaches vulnerable address parsing and linkify code

SEC-012.title: Confine the review agents' shell by the operating system, not by text matching

SEC-013.title: Throttle sign-in and HTTP Basic failures and log Basic failures
SEC-013.closedNote: resolved: in-memory throttle on both paths, and failed Basic attempts are recorded. The side effects are tracked as SEC-025.

SEC-014.title: Strip the identity header on every request and make matcher exemptions exact
SEC-014.closedNote: resolved: middleware runs on all paths, always deletes the header, and `isPublicPath` matches paths exactly.

SEC-015.title: Fail closed everywhere, not only on Fly, and remove `AUTH_DISABLED`
SEC-015.closedNote: resolved: production with no logins returns 503, `AUTH_DISABLED` is gone, and "Working as" is ignored in production.

SEC-016.title: Add a Content-Security-Policy and HSTS
SEC-016.closedNote: resolved: a nonce-based CSP in middleware, and HSTS in `next.config.ts`.

SEC-017.title: Stop accepting tokens in query strings and cap inbound body size
SEC-017.closedNote: resolved: cron accepts only the header; inbound has a 30 MB cap and at most 20 attachments; `?token=` is kept, documented, only for providers that cannot send a header.

SEC-018.title: Harden the public quote endpoint against queue flooding

SEC-019.title: Update Next to clear the PostCSS advisories
SEC-019.closedNote: resolved: a `postcss ^8.5.23` override, and `npm audit` is clean.

SEC-020.title: Use a least-privilege database role so append-only tables really are append-only

SEC-021.title: Turn `SEED_ON_EMPTY` off before loading real clients
SEC-021.closedNote: resolved: `fly.toml` now sets `SEED_ON_EMPTY = "0"`. `scripts/seed.mjs`, including `--reset`, still ships in the image; remove it before real data.

SEC-022.title: Decide and document what client data may go to Anthropic

SEC-023.title: Mask schedule-item PII (driver DOB, licence, identifiers) for users without the PII flag

SEC-024.title: Validate the `back` field before redirecting from upload and refund actions
SEC-024.closedNote: resolved: both actions now pass `back` through `safeLocalPath`.

SEC-025.title: Make the per-user sign-in throttle slow guessing without locking the real user out

SEC-026.title: Treat unverified client senders as unverified before filing attachments and auto-actioning

SEC-027.title: Require `write` for task transitions, so read-only users can't change unassigned work
SEC-027.closedNote: resolved: `mayActOn` returns false for any role without `write` or `accounting` before the unassigned-task check. Every action in `tasks/actions.ts` goes through it.

SEC-028.title: Tie the Mailgun "sender verified" result to the From domain

SEC-029.title: End a login's sessions when its password changes

SEC-030.title: Check the sender and store the sender from the same parsed address

SEC-031.title: Bound client credits and commission rates, and require accounting approval for them
SEC-031.closedNote: resolved. One part, the approval step above a threshold, was not built. That is now a choice for the agency rather than a defect.

SEC-032.title: Keep unconfirmed web leads out of email sender matching
